title: Coop Item Naming
description: Validates individual content items against Cooperative Add-On naming conventions and structure requirements. Ensures items use properly namespaced identifiers to avoid conflicts with other add-ons.

100.title: BAC ID Format
100.description: Error when a behavior animation controller ID doesn't follow the format 'controller.animation.xyz'. Use the correct prefix structure.
100.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the invalid behavior animation controller ID

101.title: BAC Name Format
101.description: Error when the name portion of a behavior animation controller doesn't follow 'creatorshortname_projectshortname' format. Use namespaced naming.
101.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the invalid BAC name portion

110.title: BA ID Format
110.description: Error when a behavior animation ID doesn't follow the format 'animation.xyz.animation_name'. Use the correct prefix structure.
110.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the invalid behavior animation ID

111.title: BA Name Format
111.description: Error when the name portion of a behavior animation doesn't follow namespaced naming conventions.
111.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the invalid BA name portion

112.title: JSON ID Format
112.description: Error when a JSON file's identifier doesn't follow the expected namespace:name format for cooperative add-ons.
112.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the invalid JSON identifier

120.title: RAC ID Format
120.description: Error when a resource animation controller ID doesn't follow the format 'controller.animation.xyz'.
120.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the invalid resource animation controller ID

121.title: RAC Name Format
121.description: Error when the name portion of a resource animation controller doesn't follow namespaced naming conventions.
121.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the invalid RAC name portion

130.title: RA ID Format
130.description: Error when a resource animation ID doesn't follow the expected format.
130.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the invalid resource animation ID

131.title: RA Name Format
131.description: Error when the name portion of a resource animation doesn't follow namespaced naming conventions.
131.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the invalid RA name portion

140.title: RC ID Format
140.description: Error when a render controller ID doesn't follow the format 'controller.render.xyz'.
140.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the invalid render controller ID

141.title: RC Name Format
141.description: Error when the name portion of a render controller doesn't follow namespaced naming conventions.
141.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the invalid RC name portion

150.title: Geometry ID Format
150.description: Error when a geometry ID doesn't follow the format 'geometry.creatorshortname_projectshortname.name'.
150.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the invalid geometry ID

151.title: Geometry Name
151.description: Error when the name portion of a geometry identifier doesn't follow namespaced naming conventions.
151.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the invalid geometry name portion

160.title: Material ID Format
160.description: Error when a material identifier doesn't use proper namespacing. Use 'namespace:material_name' format.
160.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the invalid material identifier

161.title: Material Namespace
161.description: Error when the first segment of a material identifier isn't properly namespaced.
161.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the material namespace issue

170.title: Missing Pack Scope
170.description: Error when a resource pack manifest is missing 'pack_scope': 'world' in the header. Required for cooperative add-ons.
170.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the manifest path missing pack_scope

191.title: Dimension Found
191.description: Error when dimension definition files are found in the pack. Custom dimensions are not permitted in cooperative add-ons.
191.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the path to the dimension definition
